---
title: "HSMA Books"
subtitle: "Learn at your own pace · Free to all"
body-classes: neon-title
toc: false
title-block-banner: resources/banner.png
include-back-link: false
page-layout: full
listing:
    - id: books
      contents: "hsma_content/books/book_details/*.qmd"
      sort: "date"
      type: grid
      grid-columns: 2
      categories: false
      template: html/books/listing.ejs
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Shared neon colours, fonts and .neon-tile live in styles.css (neon design language section) */

/* Bookshelf: one full-width card per book, cover on the left and its details beside it */
.book-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin: 1.5rem 0 1rem 0;
}

.book-card {
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0;
    container-type: inline-size;
}

/* The header band's underline replaces the tile's neon top edge */
.book-card::before {
    display: none;
}

/* Terminal-style header band, as on the homepage's "Updates from the HSMA team" panel,
   tinted with each book's topic colour and underlined in it */
.book-header {
    position: relative;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 30%, #1c1c1c),
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 12%, #1c1c1c) 70%);
}

.book-header::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* Override the shared listing title's forced capitalisation and padding */
.book-card .book-title {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: white;
    text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
}

.book-title .prompt {
    color: var(--accent-soft);
}

/* Cover on a black screen panel down the card's left side, as in the homepage carousel */
.book-card-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: clamp(220px, 28%, 340px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: stretch;
}

.book-cover {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    background-color: #161616;
    border-radius: 0 0 0 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.book-cover img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 6px;
    /* CRT "phosphor" grade, as on the carousel: soft highlight bloom (SVG filter below), plus a little punch */
    filter: url(#crt-bloom) contrast(1.06) saturate(1.15);
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.book-cover:hover img {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* CRT-style screen over the panel, as on the homepage carousel: faint pulsing scanlines, vignette,
   phosphor tint and edge glow (pointer-events off so the cover stays clickable) */
.book-cover::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    pointer-events: none;
    background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 60%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 100%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(224, 33, 138, 0.07), rgba(47, 140, 255, 0.07));
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255, 120, 180, 0.25);
    animation: crt-pulse 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes crt-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.7; }
    50%      { opacity: 1; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .book-cover::after {
        animation: none;
    }
}

.book-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 1.75rem 1.75rem 1.75rem 2rem;
    /* Divider between the screen panel and the details, in the book's colour */
    border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 40%, transparent);
}

/* Narrow cards (phones): screen panel above the details */
@container (max-width: 560px) {
    .book-card-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .book-cover {
        border-radius: 0;
    }

    .book-cover img {
        max-width: 320px;
    }

    .book-body {
        padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
        border-left: none;
        border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 40%, transparent);
    }
}

.book-abstract {
    flex-grow: 1;
    max-width: 75ch;   /* keep lines readable on the wide shelf cards */
    margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.book-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.55rem 1.3rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 2px solid var(--accent-soft);
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 10%, transparent);
    color: var(--accent-soft);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.book-button:hover {
    color: white;
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 22%, transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* Pointer to the modules page, matching the outlined neon buttons elsewhere */
.modules-jump {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 2px solid var(--neon-red);
    background-color: rgba(255, 45, 63, 0.08);
    color: #ff8a90;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 45, 63, 0.3);
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.modules-jump:hover {
    color: #f08cc4;
    border-color: var(--neon-magenta);
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(224, 33, 138, 0.5);
}
</style>
```

To accompany the HSMA course, we have written several eBooks.

These are freely available to all - please share them with anyone you think would find them useful!

Prefer to follow along with the original session recordings, slides and exercises? Head to the [modules](modules.qmd) page instead.

[<i class="bi bi-collection-play"></i> Go to the modules page](modules.qmd){.modules-jump}

```{=html}
<!-- CRT bloom for the covers, as on the homepage carousel: blurs the image, keeps only the brighter
     parts of the blur, and screens them back over the original -->
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position: absolute;" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <filter id="crt-bloom" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="5" result="blur"/>
    <feComponentTransfer in="blur" result="highlights">
      <feFuncR type="linear" slope="1.6" intercept="-0.6"/>
      <feFuncG type="linear" slope="1.6" intercept="-0.6"/>
      <feFuncB type="linear" slope="1.6" intercept="-0.6"/>
      <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.5"/>
    </feComponentTransfer>
    <feBlend in="SourceGraphic" in2="highlights" mode="screen"/>
  </filter>
</svg>
```
